title: Cotton Compat
description: Compat for Etcetera and Rustic Delight cotton
body:
This datapack makes the Cotton Boll and Cotton Flower from Rustic Delight and Etcetera usable in the other mod's recipes.

Specific changes:

- Added Etcetera's Cotton Flower to the forge:crops/cotton tag, which Rustic Delight already adds its Cotton Boll to.
- Added Etcetera's Cotton Seeds to the forge:seeds/cotton tag, which Rustic Delight already adds its Cotton Seeds to.
- All [Rustic Delight](https://modrinth.com/mod/rustic-delight) recipes which use its Cotton Boll now accepts any item in the forge:crops/cotton tag.
- All [Rustic Delight](https://modrinth.com/mod/rustic-delight) recipes which use its Cotton Seeds now accepts any item in the forge:seeds/cotton tag.
- All [Etcetera](https://modrinth.com/mod/etcetera) recipes which use its Cotton Flower now accepts any item in the forge:crops/cotton tag.
- All [Thigh highs etc.](https://modrinth.com/mod/thigh-highs-etc) recipes which use etc's Cotton Flower now accepts any item in the forge:crops/cotton tag.

I recommend using [Item Tag Converter](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/item-tag-converter) to consolidate the cotton items to the versions you prefer.
